course_name_original: Intelligent Systems and Technologies for Energetics
course_name_en: Intelligent Systems and Technologies for Energetics

learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize students with the complexity of solving current energy systems using alternative and renewable energy sources, energy storage technologies and measurement, control and information systems.
The student will get a basic overview of alternative and renewable energy sources, storage technologies, measurement and management of these systems.
Gets information on the context of their deployment in real-time stationary, mobile, transport / transport applications.

syllabus_topics: Alternative and renewable energy resources and their transformation.
Energy of the Sun, energy of the Earth
Photovoltaic and photothermal system. Enegeric systems grid-on, - off and the hybrid operation.
Thermal, wave, tidal and other energy systems.
Topology, measurement, control and information systems
Sensors and measurement of parameters of power systems
Control, monitoring, information and visualization systems
Converters of the energies, heat pumps, thermal generators
Alternative energy systems for traffic and transport, electromobility
Excursion PV power plant Třanovice, MSU Trianon, Czech Cieszyn, manufacturing of NiCd batteries SAFT Raskovice.
Excursion HP system of the New Aula, Storage Technology with byproduction of the hydrogen FCL Krasnopolska, Hydrogen laboratory Enet, electric car charging technology at the VSB-TUO, REC VSB-TUO.
